##### Project general facts

The Gate 3 and 4 by Arada is a pair of contemporary residential buildings at the entrance to the community, designed for an active and well-connected urban lifestyle. Each building rises above a basement level, a ground floor and a podium to the residential floors, with clean modern facades and generous glazing. The collection offers one-bedroom apartments and spacious two-, three- and four-bedroom family homes, each with a distinctive layout that supports a personalised way of living.

Residents enjoy a high-quality indoor gym, a fully equipped open-air gym and separate swimming pools for adults and children with a pool deck. A children's playground, an amphitheatre, a jogging track and a dedicated table tennis area add variety, while direct pathways lead to landscaped parks, family picnic spaces and shaded lawns. Retail outlets, healthcare services and dining venues open directly onto a tree-lined boulevard at the foot of the buildings.

Smart home technology is integrated throughout every residence, delivering seamless control of lighting, climate and security as standard. Kitchens are fitted with a premium European cooking range, an extractor hood and a washer-dryer, while modern finishes and high-quality materials create an elegant, practical backdrop for everyday life. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving furniture and decor entirely to the owner's own taste and making every apartment easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Aljada is a large master-planned community in Sharjah whose layout draws inspiration from the historic districts of the emirate, blending heritage character with contemporary design. Its heart is Madar, a family entertainment destination designed by Zaha Hadid Architects, with the Zad food truck park, a drive-in cinema, a large skate park, a gym and a trampoline centre, while the tree-lined East Boulevard, landscaped parks and shaded promenades sit within walking distance of the buildings.

Emirates Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and University City Road connect the community with the rest of Sharjah, Dubai and the northern emirates. Madar and City Centre Al Zahia are a short drive away, University City and Sharjah International Airport are close by, and Dubai International Airport and Downtown Dubai are within comfortable driving distance for daily commuters and frequent travellers.

Aljada is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the largest mixed-use destinations in Sharjah. Integrated schools, hotels, parks, a business district and extensive sports and leisure facilities attract families, students and young professionals alike. Accessible entry prices compared with Dubai and steady tenant demand support attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors.
